name: Gary Thomas Scott
office: San Gabriel Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Gary Thomas Scott is the clerk and a member of the San Gabriel Unified School District Governing Board. He says he is a retired college dean who worked in education for 38 years, including in classroom instruction and college administration. He serves on the San Gabriel Valley Regional Occupational Program Joint Board of Management.

sentences.text: Gary Thomas Scott is the clerk and a member of the San Gabriel Unified School District Governing Board.
He says he is a retired college dean who worked in education for 38 years, including in classroom instruction and college administration.
He serves on the San Gabriel Valley Regional Occupational Program Joint Board of Management.

items.text: In his 2026 candidate questionnaire, he says a school board's primary job is to hire and evaluate the superintendent, and the board approves the annual budget. He also says that social and emotional wellness is necessary for student success. He served as the board's president in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic.
